import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Create sample DataFrame
data = {"spend": [500, 1000, 1500, 800, 2000]}
df_native = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Convert to narwhals
df = nw.from_native(df_native)

# Add tier column using when-then-otherwise expression
df_with_tier = df.with_columns(
    tier=nw.when(nw.col("spend") >= 1000)
    .then(nw.lit("gold"))
    .otherwise(nw.lit("standard"))
)

# Convert back to native to display
result = df_with_tier.to_native()
print(result)

import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Create sample DataFrame
data = {"spend": [500, 1000, 1500, 800, 2000]}
df_native = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Convert to narwhals
df = nw.from_native(df_native)

# Add tier column using when-then-otherwise expression
df_with_tier = df.with_columns(
    tier=nw.when(nw.col("spend") >= 1000)
    .then(nw.lit("gold"))
    .otherwise(nw.lit("standard"))
)

# Convert back to native to display
result = df_with_tier.to_native()
